eyebrow: Cloud Deployment, Monitoring, Backup & Job-Ready Capstone · Chapter 3
subtitle: Lesson 9 · Deploying Compute & Storage

code:
az vm create \
  --resource-group rg-prod-eastus \
  --name vm-app01 \
  --image Ubuntu2204 \
  --size Standard_D2s_v5 \
  --vnet-name vnet-prod-eastus \
  --subnet snet-app-tier \
  --nsg nsg-app-tier \
  --public-ip-address "" \
  --admin-username azureuser \
  --generate-ssh-keys
caption: --vnet-name / --subnet / --nsg put the VM where Chapter 2 built it — not Azure's defaults.

eyebrow: AWS: the same discipline with run-instances
code:
aws ec2 run-instances \
  --image-id ami-0abcdef1234567890 \
  --instance-type t3.medium \
  --subnet-id subnet-0a1b2c3d4e5f67890 \
  --security-group-ids sg-0123456789abcdef0 \
  --key-name app-tier-keypair \
  --count 1
caption: --subnet-id / --security-group-ids name Chapter 2's exact resources, not the default VPC.
